{{CharInfobox| |color={{electric color}} |corecolor={{electric color light}} |bordercolor={{steel color dark}} |name=Anna |jname=アナ |tmname=Ana |image=Anna Alola.png |caption=Anna |size=250px |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Alola]] |trainer=no |game=no |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Green |hair=Teal |anime=yes |epnum=SM013 |epname=Racing to a Big Event! |enva=[[Emily Jenness]] |java=[[Azu Sakura]] }} '''Anna''' (Japanese: '''アナ''' ''Ana'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is an [[Alola TV]] event hostess and news reporter, who has appeared in several roles throughout ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'', all related to televised events. ==History== ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''=== Anna debuted in ''[[SM013|Racing to a Big Event!]]'', where she was the announcer of the [[Pokémon Pancake Race]]. She has also hosted the [[Charjabug Race]] and [[Vikavolt race]] events. In addition to begin an event hostess, Anna is also a newscaster. In ''[[SM023|Getting the Band Back Together!]]'', she read the story that [[DJ Leo]]'s {{p|Dugtrio}} had gone missing. In ''[[SM044|A Dream Encounter!]]'', Anna announced the fifteenth annual "Alola Woman of the Year" award, with {{an|Professor Burnet}} winning the title for her scientific contributions. Anna visited [[Aina's Kitchen]] for her lifestyle reporting segment in ''[[SM039|Mallow and the Forest Teacher!]]''. While she was enjoying all of [[Abe]]'s prepared dishes, the broadcast abruptly ended when {{an|Mallow}} stormed out, having had enough. In ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', Anna attended the wedding of {{an|Professor Kukui}} and Professor Burnet. Anna was filming [[Hala]] during the [[Manalo Festival]] in ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]''. She later joined the rest of Alola in showering {{an|Necrozma}} with light so it could return to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|normal form}}. In ''[[SM113|This Magik Moment!]]'', Anna was seen filming a broadcast when the Alola TV star Karpy evolved into {{p|Gyarados}} and rampaged past her. Anna was the stage presenter when {{an|Professor Kukui}} and the [[Aether Foundation]] announced the establishment of the [[Alola League]] in ''[[SM115|The Dealer of Destruction!]]''. ===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''=== Anna returned in ''[[JN076|All Out, All of the Time!]]'', where she was the commentator of the [[Pokémon Catch Adventure Race]]. ==Character== Anna is a fantastic event and television hostess. She is not afraid to show her emotions during a broadcast, like in ''[[SM023|Getting the Band Back Together!]]'' where she cried as she announced that [[DJ Leo]]'s {{p|Dugtrio}} had gone missing, or her thorough enjoyment of [[Abe]]'s food in ''[[SM039|Mallow and the Forest Teacher!]]''. While she has her script, she announces her lines with passion and an excited tone. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Anna's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Anna |pkmn=Magnezone |type1=Electric |type2=Steel |img=Anna Magnezone.png |epnum=SM013 |epname=Racing to a Big Event! |vajp= |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Magnezone}} is Anna's only known Pokémon. She used it to fly on as she hosted the [[Pokémon Pancake Race]]. Magnezone reappeared in ''[[SM041|Mounting an Electrifying Charge!]]'', where it was used to fly around the arena during the [[Charjabug race]]. Magnezone reappeared in ''[[JN076|All Out, All of the Time!]]'', fulfilling the same role for the [[Pokémon Catch Adventure Race]].
